name: How do I find hidden mold causing a smell in my room?

mainEntity.name: How do I find hidden mold causing a smell in my room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finding hidden mold often requires a thorough inspection. Start by checking areas with known moisture problems, such as around leaky pipes, under sinks, near windows, or in basements and attics. Look for water stains, peeling paint, or warped materials. Professionals use moisture meters, thermal cameras, and sometimes air sampling to detect hidden mold and its moisture source without invasive demolition. They can accurately pinpoint the affected areas and develop a remediation plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check moisture-prone areas for hidden mold. Professionals use specialized tools like moisture meters and thermal cameras to detect it accurately.
